children: BayFirst Financial launched a rights offering to sell up to 4,108,072 shares of common stock at $3.50 per share following SEC effectiveness of its S-1.
Company commenced previously announced rights offering after SEC issued Notice of Effectiveness for Form S-1.
Offering permits shareholders of record as of May 12, 2026 to purchase up to 4,108,072 shares at $3.50 each.
Final prospectus filed Sept. 1, 2026 under Rule 424(b)(3) contains additional offering details.
Prospectus and rights card being sent to eligible shareholders; Regan & Associates engaged as information agent.
